encoding: byte & 127 = country code, an index into codes (the sea takes its nearest land cell's); byte & 128 = sea. Isle of Man, Jersey and Guernsey are GB; San Marino and the Vatican IT; "other" is land of a country not named (Algeria, Tunisia, ...).
sampling: cell-centred: value (i, j) is at x0 + (i + 0.5) * cell, y0 + (j + 0.5) * cell
frame: Europe's map frame (LCC 47 N 4 E, 39/54) metres
covers: Europe's outline's bounding rectangle (35-59 N, 11 W-19.5 E) and a little more
